## Definition

A *group* is a set with an associative operation, an element $e$ with $ea = a$ for each $a$, and for each $a$ an element $b$ with $ba = e$.

## Remarks

This definition is weaker on its face, but it gives the same groups.

The map $\foo(x)$ is a bijection.
